title: Jammy Portuguese Peppercorn Bake
description: A sweet and savory Portuguese dish featuring peppercorns, this bake is perfect for a special occasion, and is sugar-free-friendly. It is made in a copper pot and has a jammy, aerated texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, eggs, and melted butter until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, port wine, ground peppercorns, vanilla extract, and salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a copper pot and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the bake warm, garnished with additional ground peppercorns if desired.
